陈少峰和秦天熙也就顺水推舟进了屋子，一进屋，这里菜肴的香气更浓郁了，两人都没有注意仍坐在那里的王野，两人四只眼睛直勾勾的盯着桌上香气四溢，摆盘精美的佳肴。

陈洛兮赶紧让两人入座，陈洛兮拿着筷子都不知道先吃哪个。便问王野：“王野，这些菜都叫什么呀？”

王野见人都落座了，也不客气，直接夹了了一个鲍鱼，边喂王笑笑边说：“这是红烧鲍鱼，我用的是三头鲍。”又指着开始介绍：“这是黄焖鱼翅，用的是上品的吕宋黄；这是草菇蒸鸡，黄酒焖鸭，银耳素烩，清炖鹿肉，茄子煮鱼；这个汤是珍珠汤。”

众人在王野说完后立刻开吃了。但是当陈洛兮夹了一个鲍鱼后，盘子里只有两个了。秦天熙和陈少峰对看一眼就要分食一个。

王野哪能不知道为什么呢，无所谓的说：“吃吧，不用给我留。”

听见这话，两人赶紧一人一个开始小口小口的品尝起来。

王笑笑可跟他俩不一样，现在也不用喂了，直接上手了。两只小手抱着一个大鲍鱼在那里“咔嚓咔嚓“的啃着。

陈洛兮也是大口嚼着鲍鱼，边嚼边说：“王野，这个鲍鱼真好吃，你怎么就做了这么四个呀，你要是做个十几二十个我也吃的完。”

王野翻了个白眼说：“小姑奶奶，你是真敢说呀！还十几二十个，我这可是三头鲍，一个就二十块，就这一盘，在四九城饭店得卖150块。这都是有价无市，现在四九城都找不到几个。”

三人立刻停下了手里的筷子，目瞪口呆的看着王野。这三人也不是缺钱的主，但是一个菜要150块，也是超出了他们的认知。

接下来就是鱼翅了，这也是好东西，王野可不客气，一筷子就夹到碗里小半盘儿。自己一口，小丫头一口。两人见王野和陈洛兮在大快朵颐，而自己就这么细嚼慢咽，明显吃亏呀！也加入了抢菜的行列。

餐桌上瞬间热闹非凡，大家为了抢菜吃，那场面简直像在进行激烈的角逐，餐盘周围全是挥舞的手臂。

到最后，所有的菜，连菜汤都被浇在米饭里吃了，四个半人吃八个菜，再加上秦天熙和陈少峰在外面已经吃了个半饱了，这一下所有人都撑得靠在椅子上。

就连小丫头都靠在王野怀里。王野从小丫头的包里拿出两个大山楂丸，喂给王笑笑一颗，递给陈洛兮一颗。

陈洛兮拿过药丸，疑惑的看着王野说：“王野，这是什么呀？怎么吃顿饭还要吃药吗？”

王野头都没抬，轻轻的揉着小丫头的肚子说：“这是大山楂丸，促进消化的。”

三人像看怪物一样看着王野。如果说这时代什么药最没用，那肯定是这大山楂丸了。吃都吃不饱，还促进消化。

陈少峰和秦天熙看着陈洛兮不停的使眼色，陈洛兮刚才也听到了龙哥的话了，立刻就明白他俩什么意思，就问：“王野，你做的这菜还有哪里能吃到呀？”

王野说：“我刚才不是说了吗？四九城饭店就有。”

“跟你做的一样吗？”

王野想了想说：“一样吧，我也没吃过。”

听到王野说四九城饭店，秦天熙和陈少峰顿时就蔫了。

王野见两人的样子说：“不是说饭店对外营业吗？凭你们的身份，偶尔吃一次应该不难吧？”

秦天熙叹了口气说：“是对外营业，但是像你做的这些，够点呛。”

王野说：“你想什么呢！还我做的这些，你知道三头鲍是什么概念吗？你知道吕宋黄有多稀少吗？去吃个鸡鸭鱼的就算了，还想吃这个！不是看不起你们，这东西你们的父辈儿应该可以吃到。”

王野继续说：“你们要是去的话，花个七八十，应该能吃顿不错的。”

秦天熙说：“算了，知道也吃不上，我们真敢去花这么多钱吃一顿，回到家腿得给打断。”

王野可不会再给他们做菜，太心疼了。

又聊了几句，王野就抱着王笑笑来到院子。王野出来对着强子招了招手，大个子立刻跑了过去。所有的人都看了过来，不明白强子为什么听王野的话。

待王野抱着王笑笑，领着强子出了院子，众人赶紧围上秦天熙和陈少峰，龙哥急不可耐的问：“熙哥峰哥知道在哪里可以吃到吗？”

秦天熙失望的说：“知道了也吃不上。”

Chen Shaofeng and Qin Tianxi followed the trend and entered the house. As soon as they entered the house, the aroma of the dishes became stronger. Neither of them paid attention to Wang Ye who was still sitting there. Their four eyes were fixed on the fragrant and beautifully arranged dishes on the table.

Chen Luoxi quickly asked the two of them to sit down. Chen Luoxi held her chopsticks and didn't know which one to eat first.Then he asked Wang Ye: "Wang Ye, what are these dishes called?"

When Wang Ye saw that everyone was seated, he was not polite. He directly picked up an abalone and fed Wang Xiaoxiao while saying: "This is braised abalone, I use three-headed abalone." He pointed and started to introduce: "This is braised shark's fin, using the top-grade Luzon yellow; this is steamed chicken with straw mushrooms, braised duck with rice wine, braised white fungus, braised venison, boiled fish with eggplant; this soup is pearl soup."

Everyone started eating immediately after Wang Ye finished speaking.But when Chen Luoxi picked up an abalone, there were only two on the plate.Qin Tianxi and Chen Shaofeng looked at each other and wanted to share one meal.

How could Wang Ye not know why? He said nonchalantly: "Eat it, don't leave it for me."

Hearing this, the two of them quickly began to taste it in small sips.

Wang Xiaoxiao is different from them. He doesn't need to feed him now and just gets started.Two small hands held a big abalone and gnawed it there.

Chen Luoxi was also chewing abalone. While chewing, she said, "Wang Ye, this abalone is so delicious. Why did you only make four of them? If you made a dozen or twenty, I could finish them."

Wang Ye rolled his eyes and said, "My aunt, you really dare to say that! There are more than ten or twenty. This is a three-headed abalone, which costs 20 yuan each. This one plate costs 150 yuan at a restaurant in Forty-Nine City. These are all priceless, and you can't even find a few in Four-Nine City now."

The three of them immediately stopped holding chopsticks and looked at Wang Ye dumbfounded.These three people are not short of money, but a dish costing 150 yuan is beyond their understanding.

Next is the shark's fin, which is also a good thing. Wang Ye is not polite, and he puts half of the plate into the bowl with just one chopstick.One bite for myself and one for the little girl.The two of them saw Wang Ye and Chen Luoxi feasting, but they were eating slowly and carefully, so they were obviously at a disadvantage!Also joined the queue of grabbing food.

The dining table became lively in an instant. Everyone was competing to grab the food. The scene was like a fierce competition, with waving arms all around the dinner plate.

In the end, all the dishes, including the vegetable soup, were poured into the rice. Four and a half people ate eight dishes. In addition, Qin Tianxi and Chen Shaofeng were already half full after eating outside, and everyone was leaning back on their chairs.

Even the little girl leaned in Wang Ye's arms.Wang Ye took out two large hawthorn pills from the little girl's bag, fed one to Wang Xiaoxiao, and handed one to Chen Luoxi.

Chen Luoxi took the pill, looked at Wang Ye doubtfully and said, "Wang Ye, what is this? Why do you still need to take medicine after a meal?"

Wang Ye didn't even raise his head, he gently rubbed the little girl's belly and said, "This is a big hawthorn pill to promote digestion."

The three of them looked at Wang Ye like a monster.If there is any medicine that is the most useless in this era, it must be this hawthorn pill.You won’t feel full even after eating, and it also promotes digestion.

Chen Shaofeng and Qin Tianxi looked at Chen Luoxi and kept winking. Chen Luoxi had just heard Brother Long's words and immediately understood what they meant, so she asked: "Wang Ye, where else can I get this dish you cooked?"

Wang Ye said: "Didn't I just say it? There is one in the Four-Nine City Hotel."

"Is it the same as what you did?"

Wang Ye thought for a while and said: "It's the same, I haven't eaten it either."

Qin Tianxi and Chen Shaofeng immediately wilted when they heard Wang Ye talking about the Four Nine City Hotel.

Wang Ye saw the two people's looks and said, "Didn't you say that the hotel is open to the public? With your status, it shouldn't be difficult to eat once in a while, right?"

Qin Tianxi sighed and said, "It's open to the public, but what you do is a bit embarrassing."

Wang Ye said: "What are you thinking! I've made these. Do you know what three-headed abalone is? Do you know how rare Luzon yellow is? Just go and eat chicken, duck and fish, and you still want to eat this! I'm not looking down on you, your parents should be able to eat this."

Wang Ye continued: "If you go, you should be able to have a good meal for seventy or eighty yuan."

Qin Tianxi said: "Forget it, I know I can't eat. If we really dare to spend so much money for a meal, our legs will be broken when we get home."

Wang Ye would never cook for them again, it was so heartbreaking.

After chatting for a few more words, Wang Ye came to the yard with Wang Xiaoxiao in his arms.Wang Ye came out and waved to Qiangzi, and the big man ran over immediately.Everyone looked over and didn't understand why Qiangzi listened to Wang Ye's words.

When Wang Ye hugged Wang Xiaoxiao and led Qiangzi out of the yard, everyone quickly gathered around Qin Tianxi and Chen Shaofeng. Brother Long asked impatiently: "Brother Xi, brother Feng, do you know where I can eat it?"

Qin Tianxi said disappointedly: "I can't eat even if I know."
